**Gateway 503 incident — on-call handoff**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, deployed by a.novak, 02:12–02:14 UTC) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Config generation 119 applied at 02:13:41. Within 33 seconds the connection pool (fixed at size 20) pinned at `in_use=20` and started failing new requests with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14 02:14:18 UTC through at least 03:59:27 UTC (end of available log — still failing, `waiting` queue had grown to 74 requests). Errors hit `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/catalog/search` across all three backend services, roughly every 4th request in bursts.

**Rollback:** revert `dep-4471` — restore `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (and optionally the timeout back to 2000ms, though that setting isn't implicated).

**Not implicated:** worker fleet was unaffected — separate connection pool, ran clean the whole window (`size=8 in_use=1 idle=7 waiting=0` throughout). No other deploy in that window (`dep-4472` billing-svc, `dep-4473` catalog-svc) touches the gateway pool.
